    intro A
    by_cases hA : A ∈ P
    · exact Or.inl hA
    · by_cases hAc : Aᶜ ∈ P
      · exact Or.inr hAc
      · obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ := hPS A hA
        obtain ⟨V, hV, hAV⟩ := hPS Aᶜ hAc
        have hu : U ⊆ Aᶜ := by
          intro x hx hxA
          have hm : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hx⟩
          exact False.elim (by simpa [hAU] using hm)
        have h : U ∩ V ≠ ∅ := hPP U hU V hV
        exfalso
        apply h
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
        intro hx
        have hm : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨hu hx.1, hx.2⟩

    intro A hA

(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)

    simpa only [Fintype.card_set] using Finset.card_add_card_compl P
  have hp : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel Fintype.card_pos]
  omega
